item.title: Talk. It types. Anywhere on your phone. $9.www.airtxt.ai
item.summary: Half the price of Wispr Flow ($9 vs $15) — proof: public pricing. On-device OR cloud, your choice — Wispr is cloud-only. Proof: the toggle, privacy angle. It also sits in your meetings — one app, dictation and a meeting bot. Wispr has neither. Works in every app via the keyboard — not a walled-garden notepad. www.airtxt.ai Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49391762 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
